list.name: customer_id
list.label: Customer
list.query: SELECT toString(customer_id) AS __value, customer_name AS __text FROM flow.exporter_map ORDER BY customer_name

targets.rawSql: WITH ext AS (SELECT if(dp, src_addr, dst_addr) AS ext_ip, sum(bytes) AS b FROM (SELECT bytes, src_addr, dst_addr, (isIPAddressInRange(src_addr,'10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(src_addr,'172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(src_addr,'192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(src_addr,'100.64.0.0/10')) AS sp, (isIPAddressInRange(dst_addr,'10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(dst_addr,'172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(dst_addr,'192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(dst_addr,'100.64.0.0/10')) AS dp FROM flow.flows_raw WHERE exporter_ip IN (SELECT exporter_ip FROM flow.exporter_map WHERE customer_id = $customer_id) AND $__timeFilter(ts)) WHERE sp != dp GROUP BY ext_ip) SELECT concat(dictGetString('flow.asn_dict','org', toUInt8(0), toUInt32(toIPv4OrDefault(ext_ip))), ' (AS', toString(dictGetUInt32('flow.asn_dict','asn', toUInt8(0), toUInt32(toIPv4OrDefault(ext_ip)))), ' ', dictGetString('flow.asn_dict','country', toUInt8(0), toUInt32(toIPv4OrDefault(ext_ip))), ')') AS Provider, sum(b) AS Bytes FROM ext GROUP BY Provider ORDER BY Bytes DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT if(dp, dst_addr, src_addr) AS `Internal IP`, sum(bytes) AS Bytes FROM (SELECT bytes, src_addr, dst_addr, (isIPAddressInRange(dst_addr,'10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(dst_addr,'172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(dst_addr,'192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(dst_addr,'100.64.0.0/10')) AS dp, (isIPAddressInRange(src_addr,'10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(src_addr,'172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(src_addr,'192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(src_addr,'100.64.0.0/10')) AS sp FROM flow.flows_raw WHERE exporter_ip IN (SELECT exporter_ip FROM flow.exporter_map WHERE customer_id = $customer_id) AND $__timeFilter(ts)) WHERE sp != dp GROUP BY `Internal IP` ORDER BY Bytes DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Traffic over time (bytes per interval — Download / Upload)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, sum(multiIf(dp, bytes, 0)) AS "Download", sum(multiIf(sp, bytes, 0)) AS "Upload" FROM (SELECT ts, bytes, (isIPAddressInRange(dst_addr,'10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(dst_addr,'172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(dst_addr,'192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(dst_addr,'100.64.0.0/10')) AS dp, (isIPAddressInRange(src_addr,'10.0.0.0/8') OR isIPAddressInRange(src_addr,'172.16.0.0/12') OR isIPAddressInRange(src_addr,'192.168.0.0/16') OR isIPAddressInRange(src_addr,'100.64.0.0/10')) AS sp FROM flow.flows_raw WHERE exporter_ip IN (SELECT exporter_ip FROM flow.exporter_map WHERE customer_id = $customer_id) AND $__timeFilter(ts)) WHERE sp != dp GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
